evidence_blockers: Dataset has not been supplied or audited.
Project checkpoint and its training provenance have not been supplied.
No held-out test metrics have been generated.
Checkpoint-to-ONNX prediction parity has not been tested.
Raspberry Pi runtime smoke test has not been run.

rule: A complete release requires an audited dataset and matching project checkpoint, reproducible held-out test metrics, ONNX prediction parity, Pi smoke test, physical/offline evidence, video review and team authorship attestation.
